body.name: Sparse switching operational acceptance \(\operatorname{Acc}_{\mathrm{sw}}\)
body.construction: Derive \(\Omega\), its canonical indices, \(M\), and \(q_M\) from \(x_{\mathrm{str}}\), and parse the supplied string using the sparse-record and exact framing conventions.  Return \(0\) for malformed input; an invalid or repeated branch index; failure of the positive indices to be exactly \(1,\ldots,M\); an invalid index-zero marker; an illegal protocol; an inconsistent or uncatalogued label; an oracle reply \(\bot\); a malformed support index; a used event \(H_{\mathrm{slice}}(S,\ell)\) of zero mass; an invalid source mask; failed measured ancestry; or an invalid concrete transcript.  Otherwise cache one reply to \(\mathcal O_{\mathrm{src}}\) for each distinct protocol, construct \(\mathcal R(E_{\mathrm{sw}})\) from the nonempty records, normalize \(Q\), and execute the complete unconditional \(\operatorname{CTFIDU}^{+}\) procedure on that decoded collection.  Return \(1\) exactly when the complete run does not return \(\operatorname{FAIL}\) and each positive-index record reproduces a successful \(\operatorname{IDENTIFY}^{+}\) branch for its named \(\alpha=(j,\omega)\).  Every source-law or support access is an explicit query charged to \(N_{\mathcal O}\).  This is an operational predicate; it does not assert semantic soundness or completeness of \(\operatorname{CTFIDU}^{+}\) under event-local positivity.
